answer: In an agent marketplace trading karst surveys and mesa maps, each seller must lock a separate bond for every active identity. A contract freezes each bond while work is pending and forfeits it if the seller misses a delivery deadline without submitting a valid result to an agreed verifier. The fable of free identities breaks down: running a thousand sellers requires a thousand bonds, tying up capital, and using them to accept work and disappear burns that capital.
